headline.html: On the same 2 GPUs and the same traffic, prefix-aware routing cut p95 time to first token by 41% versus round-robin, and served 20% more traffic within the SLO, which is 14% lower cost per million tokens.
headline.text: On the same 2 GPUs and the same traffic, prefix-aware routing cut p95 time to first token by 41% versus round-robin, and served 20% more traffic within the SLO, which is 14% lower cost per million tokens.
headline.tour: Both sides got exactly the same requests at the same times. On the same 2 GPUs and the same traffic, prefix-aware routing cut p95 time to first token by 41% versus round-robin, and served 20% more traffic within the SLO, which is 14% lower cost per million tokens.
